description: This file is a PHP library for handling CSV serialization and deserialization of database recordsets, including functions to convert recordsets to CSV format, read CSV data into recordsets, and perform file locking for cache management.

classes.name: ADORecordSet
classes.description: A class representing a database recordset, used for CSV serialization and deserialization.

classes.name: ADOFieldObject
classes.description: A class representing metadata about a database field, used when parsing CSV column definitions.

methods.name: _rs2serialize
methods.description: Converts a recordset into a CSV serialized format suitable for cache or transmission.

methods.name: csv2rs
methods.description: Reads a CSV file or URL and converts it into a recordset object.

methods.name: adodb_write_file
methods.description: Safely writes contents to a file with file locking and atomic rename for cache management.
